why_this_file_exists: tests[133] (issue_id t26) greps .github/workflows/deploy.yml and asserts that RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK is the ONLY secret the workflow may reference. The operator's approved method-2 edit adds the second secret RENDER_APP_URL, so the stored premise is falsified by the milestone itself and tests[133] is RED on exactly that one leg (measured: rc=1, 'RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK must be the ONLY secret referenced, got RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK,RENDER_APP_URL'). A stored gate that greps a product file pins a literal, and changing that literal requires a FORMAL gate-amendment card that RE-PREMISES the rule - never relaxes it. This record is that card's instrument.
re_premise_not_relax: the single-secret equality is replaced by a CLOSED two-secret allowlist plus a placement control, not by a widened bound or a deleted leg: (1) every secrets.* name in deploy.yml must be inside {RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK, RENDER_APP_URL} and RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK must still be present, so a third distinct secret REDS the gate; (2) RENDER_APP_URL may appear at most once and only after the 'Verify the deployed health endpoint' step marker, so the hook step cannot borrow it and a second reference REDS the gate. The rule is different but no weaker: RENDER_DEPLOY_HOOK remains the only deploy-hook secret, the plaintext hook URL stays forbidden (the api.render.com/deploy/ leg is untouched), and the workflow now has a named second secret with a named job.
